note: Glass-of-water cascade, stage 3 (macro / observer band). Emits the fluid parameters the macroscopic position-based-fluid solver actually consumes, from the meso density + cohesion strength. macro_rest_density passes through (identity, grounded ~999 kg/m^3). macro_surface_tension_coeff (the PBF s_corr clustering strength that makes drops cohere and MERGE on contact) and macro_viscosity_coeff (the XSPH damping) are ILLUSTRATIVE linear reads of the cohesion strength (labelled) -- the point is that the scenario hand-types NO macroscopic water property: how cohesive/viscous the glass of water behaves is inferred from the nanoscale hydrogen-bond coordination, up the ladder, by the cascade.
